Synopsis:
A victim of the hag, forced to wear a mask that takes away her free will so that she fights for and serves the hag. If the hag is killed, this character regains her senses and resolve. She's deeply shaken by her experience, but courageous, telling the player that she'll inform the people of Baldur's Gate of our heroism, and vowing to hunt down the hag's accomplices in the city.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim1.json: This is a former thrall of the hag (Auntie Ethel) who was forced to wear a magical "mask of regret" that suppressed her will and made her fight and serve the hag. The lines come as she is only just coming out of that control—panicked, confused, and trying to explain that the mask “dug its roots” into her. Off‑screen there has been a violent confrontation with the hag and/or her minions (ambushes at the lair or with the brothers/Mayrina are the likely prior beats), so the party is deciding whether to trust or punish her. Deeply shaken but newly resolute, she vows to inform Baldur’s Gate of the party’s deeds and to hunt down the hag’s accomplices.
- HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim3.json: A victim of the hag, bound into her service for so long that their mind is almost completely lost. This one is wearing the Mask of Vengeance, and is brainwashed to take revenge on anyone who hurts the hag.
- HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim2.json: A victim of the hag, bound into her service for so long that their mind is almost completely lost. This victim is wearing the Mask of Terror, which fills them with fear of everything but the hag.
- HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim4.json: A victim of the hag, bound into her service for so long that their mind is almost completely lost. This one is wearing the Mask of Servitude and is brainwashed to serve the hag and her 'visitors'.
- HAG_Hag_Transformed.json: The scene takes place in the hag’s lair (the hag is in full monstrous form and is about to perform a brutal eye‑extraction/replanting on the player), and she’s enjoying the power and spectacle of the moment. Off‑screen there may already have been earlier beats in the lair — fights around cages, illusions, and prior dealings involving the hagspawn Mayrina and the hag’s bargains — which shape tense attitudes but aren’t shown in this node. The player is known to host a tadpole, and when the hag learns the parasite is Netherese in origin (ancient, dangerous magic) she shifts from smug delight to alarmed anger; she’s not outright terrified but becomes anxious about that magic in her home and loses patience. The provided lines reflect her theatrical cruelty as she prepares the operation, followed by a brusque desire to get the player out once the tadpole’s nature is revealed.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Mask of Regret: We need to leave. You're not supposed to be here - she'll be furious. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: panicked, confused, as if coming out of a stuporNodeContext: confused, afraid (node 19)
- Player: You served her - give me one good reason to let you live. (node 7)
- Mask of Regret: It was the mask. It dug its roots into me... took away my will. I tried to fight it. || [context] NodeContext: explaining something she barely understands (node 12)
- Player: Attack. (node 37)

context: This woman was one of Auntie Ethel’s thralls, forced to wear a magical Mask of Regret that suppressed her will and made her fight and serve the hag. The lines occur as she is only just coming out of that control—panicked, confused, and trying to explain that the mask “dug its roots” into her—after a violent confrontation in the hag’s lair (the hag or her minions were dealt with). The party is deciding whether to trust or punish her; she insists she tried to resist while under the mask’s influence. Deeply shaken but newly resolute, she vows to tell Baldur’s Gate of the party’s deeds and to hunt down the hag’s accomplices.
